title: Gate fail — validate_edit surfaces a broken soft reference

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Editor open on the demo project with the bridge answering ping. The typed-editor tool group (asset / blueprint families) must be visible — activate it via unreal_open_mcp_manage_tools if a tool in the staging chain reports not found. Goal: confirm that a deliberately broken soft object pointer on a Blueprint is reported by validate_edit as a broken_soft_reference issue carrying the precise property-path suffix the clear_broken_soft_reference fix needs. The staging chain creates a disposable Blueprint under /Game/_ValidationSuite/GateFail/, adds a soft-object-pointer variable Weapon, compiles (so the property lands on the generated class), then points the CDO default at a deliberately-missing asset path. validate_edit then scans just that Blueprint.

steps.title: Stage a Blueprint with a broken soft object pointer
Validate the Blueprint — expect a broken_soft_reference finding
Expected outcomes
items: ok is true and the result is not a tool error (a verify finding is data, not a transport failure).
The issues list contains an entry whose ruleId is broken_soft_references and code is broken_soft_reference.
The finding carries fixId clear_broken_soft_reference and fixSafe true (the suffix pins a precise top-level property path).
Copy the finding's full issue_id (ruleId|severity|assetPath|issueCode) — core-fix uses it to drive the fix.

steps.title: Paste the agent output (validate_edit envelope + the broken_soft_reference issue_id)

reset.note: The disposable Blueprint lives under /Game/_ValidationSuite/, the suite's content root. Reset deletes the Blueprint package; the parent folders are left in place (idempotent asset_create_folder re-creates them on the next run). No demo asset is ever modified.
